name: Meier-Gorlin症候群

summary.text: A rare microcephalic primordial dwarfism characterized by the association of bilateral microtia (severe hypoplasia of ear pinnae), absent patellae, short stature and characteristic facial features such as high forehead, micrognathism with full lips and small mouth, and accentuated nasolabial folds (smile wrinkles linking the nostrils to the labial commissure).
